purpose: Operational readiness gate for starting V6.16 Situation Learning. This gate does not validate investment effectiveness and does not require any Promotion Gate pass.

rationale.why_20d_12: 12 effective symbol×non-overlapping-20d-block units prove repeated medium-horizon maturation without claiming alpha efficacy.
rationale.why_60d_6: 6 effective symbol×non-overlapping-60d-block units prove repeated long-horizon maturation without claiming alpha efficacy.
rationale.why_multiple_families: Avoid declaring readiness from a single narrow rule family implementation path.
rationale.expected_first_60d_window: approximately late December 2026 to early January 2027
rationale.effective_unit: symbol x non-overlapping horizon block; author count is separate

power_reference.note: This reference is for Promotion evidence planning only. Readiness minima do not imply power to validate alpha; multiplicity and dependence generally require more evidence.

guardrails: Readiness and Promotion are independent gates.
A V6.16 start decision cannot require any method or family to pass Promotion.
Requirements cannot be relaxed after observing favorable investment results.
Passing this gate authorizes architecture work only, never automatic trading or production-rule mutation.
